item.description:

$10. Thank you for the support!
Mashup Mondays every Monday at One World Brewing West with special guests and different music every week!!
The JLloyd MashUp explores different genres of music including Acid Jazz, Funk, Soul, Afro Beat, Reggae, Break Beat, and Latin. Led and curated by Jonathan Lloyd (The Fritz/Dubconscious/Cadillac Jones), the band is made up of some of Asheville’s busiest and hardest working musicians on the scene.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Fitness Hike - Bent Creek, Hard Times Trailhead to MST and up to Cold Knob — Tue Nov 24, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **Note to Regulars: This hike is on Tuesday, Not Wednesday!**
**Description:** We will work our way from the Hardtimes trailhead up to the MST and head towards Sleepy Gap We will continue past Chestnut Cove overlook to the Cold Knob trail. We will climb up Cold Knob and have snacks or lunch there. We will then retrace our steps back to the trailhead.
Elevation Gain: approximately 2,360'. Distance: Approx. 11.66 miles.
**PACE:** This is a BRISK PACE Fitness Hike averaging 2.5 MPH (on steeper climbs) to 3+MPH on the flatter / downhill sections with brief regrouping as needed and at trail intersections. This hike is not for the casual hiker. Please know your hiking abilities before signing on. If you are new to our fitness hikes and have questions message me directly or post on this site..
**DOGS:** are welcome.
**Carpool : Arrange your own carpooling . Please post in the comments section of this post if you wish to ride share so you can coordinate with oth

item.title: Winter Lights — Tue Nov 24, 6:00 PM — The North Carolina Arboretum
item.description: Asheville’s Brightest Holiday Tradition! Winter Lights is a walk-through holiday spectacular featuring over one million lights. Winter Lights shines a glow on the natural world and majestic gardens of the Arboretum. This year’s show will introduce new sights and sounds that transport guests through a spectacular and enchanting evening. Revel in Winter Lights as the formal gardens are illuminated with immersive displays and new experiences like the deep and inviting “Forest Floor” where mushrooms carpet the ground. Stroll below the lily pads in “Beneath the Riverbed” or wander among the giant dragonflies in “Between Water and Woods.” Winter Lights features live entertainment nightly and food and beverages from the Bent Creek Bistro, the Cocoa Shack and the Cocoa Cabin! Open nightly from 6:00 – 10:00 p.m. Tickets on Sale Now! item.title: Walk the Moon Tree Way at Haywood Community College — Sun Dec 20, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Haywood County Walking Meetup Group Haywood Community College has long been known for having a tree grown from a seed taken on a moon mission. Now there are two trees near each other. We will be watching for those trees when we walk at HCC on December 20.
To get to Moon Tree Way from our start point, we will go counterclockwise on the Bobcat Trail until we get to the Bird and Butterfly Garden. From there we will walk past Ironwood, past the Moon Trees, and then go behind the Dahlia Garden. From there we will rejoin Bobcat Trail to finish our first loop. Our second loop will be totally on the Bobcat Trail. All together, it isn't over 3 miles. Part of the walk is on pavement, part on well-groomed trail, and part on not-as-well groomed trail. There is some small elevation change.
As you enter the campus from Jones Cove Road, go to the first parking lot on the left. We will gather there and then head out.

item.title: Old Fort Boxing Day 5KM/3 mile Walk — Sat Dec 26, 12:00 PM
item.description:
Haywood County Walking Meetup Group Meet at Old Fort Town Hall, 38 Catawba Avenue, at 12:00 noon. (I'm not sure how difficult parking will be, so come a bit early just in case.) We will walk, making a leisurely loop of the route some 5 KM runs follow.
We will see parts of the town and a bit of countryside as well.
Dress for the weather. Tennis shoes should be fine. There is some elevation change; I plan to take a walking stick, though most won't need one. Bring plenty of water and a protein snack. Dogs are welcome. Strollers should be ok.
If you don't want to face crowds in the stores exchanging gifts, this Boxing Day walk just might fit the bill. I hope to see you there.
